meta.title: Features · YukSaroy
meta.description: Find, list, book and settle, data: the platform's real features with links.

features.title: The market works in four steps
features.lead: Every feature leads to a page. What is here is what the catalog has: a link, not a promise.

find.title: Find
find.lead: Terminals, equipment and road transport in one place.

list.title: List
list.lead: The owner writes it and answers it.

book.title: Book and settle
book.lead: Open prices, frozen tariff, documents in the dashboard.

catalog.title: Catalog and filters
catalog.body: Terminals (rail sidings included), equipment, road transport: by region, service, type and price.

map.title: Map
map.body: Every object on one map, in sync with the list. Near me and by corridor.

assistant.title: Assistant search
assistant.body: Type one line: region, service, equipment, date. Dictionary first, AI only when needed.

compare.title: Compare
compare.body: Up to four objects in one table: tariff, spot, distance, rating.

hubs.title: Region pages
hubs.body: A page per region: terminals, sidings, listings.

listing.title: Equipment and carrier listing
listing.body: Locomotive, wagon, truck: rent or sale. Standard check, photos, price.

terminal.title: Terminal page
terminal.body: Services, tariffs, hours, spots. The owner runs it from the dashboard.

siding.title: Claim a siding
siding.body: Find your siding in the registry, send an ownership claim, the page becomes yours.

premium.title: Premium
premium.body: Listing ranked first in the list and on the map, with a badge. Monthly, per listing.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: 30-day views by surface: list, map, page, compare, bot. Inquiry count.

quote.title: Price quote
quote.body: Tariff × weight + extra services. No login, open formula.

booking.title: Spot booking
booking.body: Pick a free window today, the order goes to the terminal, answer within the SLA.

frozen.title: Frozen tariff and documents
frozen.body: The price is fixed when the order is sent. Act and invoice PDF at the end.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: Only the owner of a completed order rates. The terminal replies.

urgent.title: Urgent request
urgent.body: Locomotive call, wagon repair, crane: providers in the region send offers.

registry.title: Rail terminal registry
registry.body: Sidings across the country by station and junction, each with a terminal page. Coordinates are approximate, junction level.

standards.title: Listing standard
standards.body: Required and recommended fields per type. Not a certificate, a completeness measure.

companies.title: Companies and KYC
companies.body: Organization page, object counts, verified tax ID badge.

blog.title: Blog
blog.body: A siding as a terminal, wagon rental, bonded warehouse, free slots: short explainers.

s1.title: Find
s1.body: Catalog, map or one line of search: region, service, equipment type.

s2.title: Compare
s2.body: Tariffs, today's spots and distance side by side, up to four objects in one table.

s3.title: Connect
s3.body: The owner's phone and the inquiry form in the dashboard. No middleman.

s4.title: Book
s4.body: Pick a spot, the tariff freezes, act and invoice at the end.

meta.title: Assistant search · YukSaroy
meta.description: Type one line, the platform turns it into filters. Dictionary first, AI only at low confidence. Guests 10 a day, users 100.

assistant.title: Type one line, we set the filters
assistant.lead: The assistant turns a query into filters: region, service, equipment type, date. It never invents objects, prices or availability; it relies only on catalog data.

example.heading: Real example
example.query: Free container spot in Tashkent today
example.decision: {terminals, plural, one {# terminal} other {# terminals}} · {free} free today

source.llm: AI used for a closer reading

example.unavailable: The numbers in this example could not be refreshed; the last known state is shown.

rule.heading: The rule
rule.r1: Dictionary first: regions, stations, services and equipment names come from the dictionary. Free and unlimited.
rule.r2: AI is called only when confidence is below {threshold} or unresolved words remain; the answer takes at most 8 seconds.
rule.r3: AI returns filters only: it never invents objects, prices or availability. Regions come only from the code list.
rule.r4: If AI is unavailable or the quota is spent, the dictionary result is shown. Search never stops.

limits.heading: Limits
limits.user: Signed-in user: {n} AI queries a day
limits.note: The counter resets at midnight Tashkent time. Dictionary search is unlimited.
